Can someone please post an instruction on how use google font on a voat theme. Thanks!
How do you change the theme font?

This should work just fine - just be sure to remove the space between @ and import and change the font name and weights to the Google Font you want to use.

@ import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css?family=Lato:400,100,300');

 * {
 font-family: 'Lato', sans-serif !important;
 }
Thanks! What about the body font color?

I would use the following instead of the * selector:

body {
 font-family: 'Lato', sans-serif;
 color: #f00;
}
